title: Boba Fett
description: BOBA FETT is the most notorious bounty hunter in the galaxy. He is sheathed in armor like that worn by the Mandalore warriors when they were defeated by the Jedi Knights during the Clone Wars. It is rigged with numerous weapons including a missile-firing back pack, wrist laser and rocket darts. Boba Fett, flying his distinctively-shaped Slave I, is hired by Darth Vader to pursue the Millennium Falcon and capture Han Solo.
